opportunities.name: KAYAK hotel search with dates, guests and sort
opportunities.description: On KAYAK Stays, search a destination for given check-in/check-out dates, set rooms/adults/children, then apply filters and sort by price low to high.
steps: Open KAYAK and click Stays
Type destination in search box and select the matching autocomplete suggestion
Open date picker and click check-in then check-out dates
Open rooms/guests dropdown and increment rooms/adults/children to target counts (set child age if needed)
Click Search/Update
Optionally apply filters (hotel class, review score, amenities, style)
Open sort dropdown and choose Price (low to high)

instances.values: Le Marais Paris, Mar 27-Apr 2, 2 rooms 3 guests, sort price low to high
Santa Fe NM, Jun 16-18, 2 rooms 3 guests
Kashi Vishwanath Temple Varanasi, Jun 6-10, 2 rooms, 3 adults+1 child age 7, filters 8+ score, 3 stars, free internet, family, air-conditioned, price low to high
Los Angeles, May 21-23, 1 room 2 guests, 5-star filter

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways hotel search via Booking.com partner
opportunities.description: From Qatar Airways Book > Hotels, search a destination with check-in/out dates, optionally sort by price, set guests/rooms and filter results.
steps: Click Book in top nav then Hotels
Type destination and choose autocomplete option
Pick check-in and check-out dates in calendar
Optionally set adults/children/rooms
Click Search
Sort by price (lowest first) and/or apply filters (5 stars, free WiFi, neighbourhood)
Open a result and click See availability/Reserve

instances.values: Las Vegas, Apr 10-16, sort price lowest first
Washington DC, Jun 5-6, 4 adults 2 rooms, filters 5 stars, free WiFi, Downtown DC

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On Qatar Airways, enter origin, destination, departure date and passenger counts/class, then show flights and select a fare.
steps: Open Book > Flights (or Stopover) form
Type origin and choose autocomplete airport
Type destination and choose airport
Set trip type and open depart date picker; select date (Continue)
Open Passengers/Class; adjust adults/children/infants and cabin class; Confirm
Click Show flights
Click fare price then Select fare for each leg

instances.values: Colombo to New York, 24 Jun, 2 adults 1 child, Premium/Business
Show flights and select fares for Colombo-Doha and Doha-New York
Doha to Durban, 28 May, 2 adults 1 infant, Economy, select fare

opportunities.description: Look up flight status on Qatar Airways by origin and destination airport.
steps: Click Flight status tab
Type origin and select airport
Type destination and select airport
Click Search flights
